title: Your Brain Eats Itself Without Sleep
hook: Skip sleep and your brain *eats itself*

scenes.text: Skip sleep, and your brain starts eating itself.

In 2017, Italian researchers kept mice awake for days. Inside their brains, cleanup cells called astrocytes began devouring pieces of the connections between neurons. A little of this is normal maintenance. Under chronic sleep loss, it went into overdrive.
It's one study, in mice. But the message is blunt. Sleep is when your brain repairs itself.
Without it, it starts cutting. So tonight, remember...
